Business · Festive season

Our biggest festive season ever

Background storyThe festive season, from Navratri to Diwali, is when India buys the most cars.

19,039 cars sold. 44% more than last year.

Vikram shared what these numbers really say: more first-time car owners, more people trusting us, and car ownership getting simpler for families across India.

Business · 7 Nov · UAE

Alba Cars joins Cars24!

Background storyDubai, 2015. Talib starts Alba Cars with a few parking spots below his apartment, and car photos shot like a magazine.

Eleven years later, Alba is a premium showroom with 200+ people, selling cars at about twice our average price. Now it is part of Cars24, with Talib still leading it. Alba brings premium, showroom-style selling; Cars24 brings loans, insurance, our refurbishment lab and technology.

1,000+cars a month in the UAE, together
~300cars a month sold by Alba
4 in 5Alba customers come straight to Alba

Why it matters: Together we sell more used cars in the UAE than any other retailer.

Business · Apr–Sep 2026

The half-year report card

Background storyEvery six months the company checks how the business is doing. Here's April to September 2026.

Cars sold up 29%. Revenue up 33%.

GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) is the total value of cars sold through us; revenue is what Cars24 itself earns. Our operating loss came down to about 1% of GMV, and services like insurance earned ₹160 Cr+, 4 times last year.

₹5,300 Cr+of cars bought & sold
₹921 Crrevenue, up 33%+
+68%cars delivered to customers

Why it matters: More people buy through us, and we earn more on each sale.

Our biggest co-lending month ever

Background storyCo-lending means Cars24 gives a customer's car loan together with a big lending partner, like Bajaj Finance.

₹246 Cr co-lent in October, our best month ever.

We earn almost the same on each loan but use much less of our own money. In October, loan decisions also got faster: from about 1 hour to 30 minutes.

₹194 Crco-lent in September, up 35%
87%of our loans now co-lent
₹246 Crin October, a new high

Hubs · 26 Oct · Bangalore

Our first Training Academy is open

Background storyJakkur, Bangalore. This is our first academy built just for our frontline teams.

The academy is for our frontline, on-ground teams. Anyone who joins Cars24 in Bangalore now learns, practises and grows right here at the hub. It was opened by three of our best performers: Uma (Care Crew), Gopal (WSM) and Prateek (Car Advisor).

What the training covers:

  • Classroom theory, then hands-on practice on real cars, so what you learn is what you do on the floor.
  • First up: a CJ refresher. Day 1 was led by Mohammad Fayaz, our technical trainer for the South.
  • Batches all week, covering all 90 Bangalore CJs and 15 WSMs.
1stCars24 Training Academy
90Bangalore CJs in week one
15WSMs too

Why it matters: Every new frontline joiner in Bangalore now trains in one place, with classroom lessons and real cars.

08

Tech · 2 Nov · AI

Phoenix: our new home for AI agents

Background storyAn AI agent is software that can understand a request and act on it, like answering a customer and raising a ticket. Our first platform for these, AIRO, runs 45+ agents.

One agent used to do the whole job. Now a team of agents shares it.

Phoenix is the bigger platform that comes after AIRO. Specialist agents split a job and pass it along, so AI can take on harder work and cost less to run. First up: our Support agent, which reads a customer's query, sends it to the right team and opens a ticket. Next: agents that work towards a goal on their own, voice agents, and building agents straight from Claude or Codex.

45+AI agents on AIRO today
1.5 lakhAI conversations a day
4,000queries a day, already on Phoenix

Why it matters: Harder jobs can now be handed to AI, at a lower cost.

Product · Autopilot app

Pilots can now see demand before it reaches them

Background storyPilots are the drivers who pick up and move our cars. Until now, a pilot heard about a trip only when it was sent to them.

See where the cars are needed, and get there first.

Opportunities & Insights is a live heat map inside the Autopilot app. It shows where cars need picking up or inspecting, and where other pilots already are, so pilots spread out instead of crowding one area. Kashish Kapadia built it from the first idea to launch. Read the Slack post →

Top 7cities live, more coming
3views: first, middle and last mile
Livepickups and inspection demand

Why it matters: Pilots reach customers sooner, and fewer trips wait.

11

Product · 28 Oct

Deemed Ownership is live

Background storyWhen a used car is sold, the RC (registration) has to move to the new owner at the RTO. That can take weeks, and the seller worries until it's done.

Deemed Ownership fixes that worry. As soon as we buy a car, we file a government form (Form 29C) and Cars24 becomes the car's "deemed owner". From that moment, we take responsibility for the car, and the seller gets proof with the exact time it happened. The RC name change at the RTO follows as a separate step.

Its backend went live on 28 October, and it reached the Cars24 app in early November.

Instantwe take responsibility for the car
2 stateslive today
Decemberdecision on going all-India

Why it matters: Sellers can hand over their car without worrying about what happens next.

Ubuntu: a thank-you evening for our frontline
